trabajos.prompt: Use the exact art style of the reference images. In-game screenshot {CAMARA_JUEGO} Night on the hilltop lookout beside a lighthouse: {PROTAGONISTA} looks through a large white refractor telescope on a stone viewing deck, and {GATO} sits on the stone railing beside them, looking up at the sky. The base of a white lighthouse with terracotta bands sends a soft sweeping beam across the deck. Warm string lights between wooden posts, a stone bench, coin-operated binoculars, potted plants, the mosaic stair path climbing up the hill, rooftops of colorful houses far below with warm windows. Cool blue moonlight from a thin crescent Moon low in the west, out of frame, warm practical lights, long soft shadows, a few fireflies. {ESTILO} {SIN_TEXTO}

Game interface mockup, full screen: the telescope view of a stylized exploration RPG at a hilltop lookout at night. Left two thirds: a large circular telescope eyepiece view with a soft dark vignette and a thin cyan crosshair reticle. Inside it, a photorealistic grayscale Moon as seen tonight from the equator: a thin waxing crescent about 12 percent illuminated, lying almost horizontally like a smile, with the bright curved edge along the bottom of the disk, tilted very slightly to the right, and the rest of the disk faintly visible in soft gray earthshine against a starry sky. Two small cyan callout lines with tiny labels: one pointing at the line between lunar day and night labeled "Terminador", one pointing at the dim part of the disk labeled "Luz cenicienta". Bottom-left, overlapping the edge of the eyepiece: {GATO}, exactly like the first reference image, sitting upright with one paw raised like a presenter, with a speech bubble of torn notebook paper that reads "¿Ves la sonrisa? Cerca del ecuador, la Luna creciente se ve acostada." Right third: a column of data cards on torn cream graph paper with ink lettering, headed "Luna · esta noche", listing "Fase: creciente", "Iluminada: 12 %", "Distancia: 403 151 km", "Tamaño aparente: 29,6′", "Altura: 20°", "Se pone: 21:05", and a small footer "Fuente: JPL Horizons · 12 nov 2026 · 19:30 · Guayaquil". Top-left title "Mirador del Faro · Telescopio" beside a small lighthouse emblem. Bottom bar with small key caps and hints: "E Enfocar", "Q Acercar", "R Marcar", "Esc Salir". The interface follows the engineer's field-notebook style of the second reference image: cream graph paper, ink lines, torn paper edges, petrol blue and cyan accents. The Moon is photographic; the interface and the cat are stylized like the game. No logos.
